headlines.title: Apple reports outages after internal update, says it is working to get systems back online
headlines.description: Apple said it was experiencing tech issues Tuesday that were affecting several of its popular consumer-facing services.

headlines.title: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ if asked to return as Nvidia CEO
headlines.description: Jensen Huang said Tuesday that he would be “honored” to return to his job as CEO of Nvidia if the chip giant’s board of directors decided to bring him back.

headlines.title: Trump brushes aside concerns about outages
headlines.description: President Donald Trump brushed off recent mass outages that wreaked havoc on air travel, banks and emails, saying Tuesday, “it’s life.”

headlines.title: U.S. closes loophole that let Chinese companies use top AI chips in foreign data centers
headlines.description: The Commerce Department further restricted the sale of American AI chips, addressing concerns about how Chinese companies might evade U.S. export restrictions.

headlines.title: California sues ChatGPT maker OpenAI over rogue hacking incidents
headlines.description: California Attorney General Rob Bonta filed a sweeping lawsuit against OpenAI on Monday, alleging the technology giant jeopardized public safety by creating AI models “without the safeguards and monitoring necessary to adequately protect” people.

headlines.title: Outages reported at the NSA and Apple
headlines.description: A classified computer network used by the National Security Agency went down due to a technical problem. It comes as Apple was experiencing a tech issue that was affecting a several of its consumer-facing services. Mitch Ashley, VP of the Futurum Group, discusses how concerned we should be after several outages were reported across banking, aviation and tech.

headlines.title: Crash Involving Waymo Self-Driving Cars in Phoenix Injures 3
headlines.description: Surveillance video shows the moment an SUV crashed into two Waymo self-driving cars in Phoenix. Three people were hospitalized, with at least one suffering life-threatening injuries.

headlines.title: Jensen Huang says he would be 'honored' to return to Nvidia as CEO
headlines.description: In his first public comments since stepping down, Jensen Huang says he “would be honored” to return as CEO of Nvidia if asked by the board of directors. NBC News’ Allie Canal and editor-in-chief at Investopedia, Caleb Silver, break down Huang’s remarks and what they could mean for the company’s future leadership.

headlines.title: Outages impact Chase banking online and in person
headlines.description: A nationwide outage is impacting Chase banking services, leading some customers to report trouble accessing their accounts and withdrawing funds. The issues were affecting both online and in-person branch transactions. NBC News' Brian Cheung discusses whether there is any relation to the Microsoft outage or FAA ground stop.

headlines.title: Customers report difficulty accessing online Chase accounts
headlines.description: Some customers are reporting issues with Chase banking services online and at some branches in person. NBC News’ Brian Cheung reports on the latest developments as officials investigate the cause.

headlines.title: Trump says he ‘would not mind’ if Jensen Huang returned to lead Nvidia
headlines.description: President Trump said he “wouldn’t mind” if Jensen Huang were reinstated as CEO of Nvidia after he was ousted following allegations of multiple extramarital affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy. NBC News’ Garrett Haake details what tech leaders are saying about the scandal.

headlines.title: SpaceX Rocket Successfully Catches Part of Starship Rocket
headlines.description: A SpaceX Starship Rocket successfully returned from orbit and was caught by mechanical arms on the launchpad. It’s the latest milestone as SpaceX hopes to create fully reusable rockets.
